observation: A ratified audit was wrong and its conclusion had survived five independent critique rounds. feasibility.md P3 concluded 'exactly TWO cross-boundary atomic pairs exist... and no third'; the real number was NINE transactions carrying TEN orchestration writes. Two structural reasons: (1) it searched for literal callee spellings (enqueueWorkIntent(, createSessionRequest(, agentWorkIntentRecorder.record(, tx as HyperIdleDb), but most sites never write the function's name - the write arrives as an injected dependency (deps.workIntents.record(tx,...)) in files that import no agent-orchestration package at all; (2) it scoped itself to layers/core-api/src, excluding the four service packages where FIVE of the nine sites live. Six of the nine were classified 'uncoupled' because the transaction opens one or two frames below the inspected call site. The list was re-swept repeatedly across the rounds; the METHOD was never checked.
evidence: feasibility.md:102-149 (P3 table + 'Verdict - WRONG' + P3b's two structural reasons); architecture.md:26 ('the audit's method'); progress.json:142 (amendment gap1)
